verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a SaaS tax-compliance platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such opt-out control. The note that the MCP server reads only public docs and never sees credentials is about credential handling, not telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
